relationships.subject: S1 neuronal synchronization
relationships.evidence_quote: This hypersynchrony is not a mere by-product of pain, rather, it is critical for pain-like behavior, including spontaneous pain.

key_findings: Trigeminal nerve root compression (FLIT model) induced synchronized firing of S1ULp–S1J neurons underpinned by local GABAergic interneuron hypoactivity.
Chemogenetic inhibition of pain-induced c-Fos neurons, activation of S1 GABAergic interneurons, carbamazepine or nerve decompression reduced S1 synchrony and alleviated pain-like behavior.
novel_terms: foramen lacerum impingement of trigeminal nerve root
